basic_info.description: On a high floor of a 1931 Pacific Heights gem, this fully renovated 3BD/2.5BA condo delivers classic elegance and modern luxury. Thoughtful upgrades include built-in ceiling speakers, Lutron Homeworks lighting, heated floors, and Venetian plaster walls. The chef's kitchen is both a showstopper and built to perform. Oversized living room windows and bedroom views showcase spectacular, wide-open vistas of San Francisco Bayfrom Alcatraz to the Golden Gate Bridge.    One of the building's best parking spaces (EV charger ready) and a generous storage cage are included.    1870 Jackson Street stands out with its tailored black awning, vaulted beamed lobby, arched doorways, and rich wood detailing. A rare opportunity to own a high-style, move-in-ready home in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods.
